duplicate_groups.pattern: select n1 from n2 where n3 = ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: What's the reference name of Marina Bay Street Circuit?
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select distinct n2.n1 from n3 as n2 inner join n4 as n5 on n2.n6 = n5.n6 where n5.n7 = ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: Who are the players that tend to be attacking when their mates were doing attack moves? List down their name.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select distinct n2.n1, n2.n3 from n4 as n2 inner join n5 as n6 on n6.n7 = n2.n7 where n6.n8 = ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select cast(sum(n4.n8) as real) / count(n4.n3) from n1 as n5 inner join n2 as n4 on n5.n6 = n4.n6 where n5.n7 = ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.`date`) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

duplicate_groups.example_nl: Among the players whose preferred foot was the left foot when attacking, how many of them would remain in his position when the team attacked?
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select n2.n1 from n3 as n5 inner join n4 as n2 on n5.n6 = n2.n6 where n5.n7 = ? and n2.n8 like ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: Tell the build Up play passing class for "FC Lorient" on 2010/2/22.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT t2.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2010-02-22%'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select distinct n2.n1 from n3 as n2 inner join n4 as n5 on n2.n6 = n5.n6 where n5.n7 = (select max(n7) from n4)
duplicate_groups.example_nl: State the name of the most strongest player.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

duplicate_groups.pattern: select n2.n1 from n3 as n5 inner join n4 as n2 on n2.n6 = n5.n6 where n5.n7 = ? order by n5.n8 desc limit ?
duplicate_groups.example_nl: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT T2.driverRef FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 20 ORDER BY T1.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

duplicate_groups.pattern: select n2.n1 from n3 as n5 inner join n4 as n2 on n2.n6 = n5.n6 where n5.n7 = ? and n5.n8 like ?

duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT T2.number FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 903 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:54%'

duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

duplicate_groups.example_nl: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'

duplicate_groups.pattern: select n2.n1 from n3 as n4 inner join n1 as n2 on n4.n5 = n2.n6 where n4.n7 = ?

duplicate_groups.pattern: select sum(case when n4.n7 = ? then ? else ? end) - sum(case when n4.n7 = ? then ? else ? end) from n1 as n3 inner join n2 as n4 on n3.n5 = n4.n6
duplicate_groups.example_nl: Between DC and Marvel Comics, which publisher has published more superheroes? Find the difference in the number of superheroes they have published.
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id

duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.hero_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Stealth'

duplicate_groups.example_nl: What is the hero's full name with the highest attribute in strength?
duplicate_groups.example_sql: SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Strength' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1
